scripts.dev: npm run build -w @beyond/api && concurrently -k -n api,types,web -c cyan,gray,yellow "npm run dev -w @beyond/api" "npm run watch -w @beyond/api" "npm run dev -w @beyond/web"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.test: npm run build -w @beyond/web && npm run test -w @beyond/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @beyond/api && npm run build -w @beyond/web
